props.name: revealSignature
props.description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers enter replay when it changes.

props.name: revealOn
props.description: When the enter reveal is allowed to play (#175). `"mount"` (default) plays as soon as the chart renders — no change from today. `"inView"` holds the bars at their pre-enter state until this chart's own container scrolls to 30% visible.

props.name: replayOnClick
props.description: Clicking the chart body replays the enter reveal (#175). Default `false`.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: status
props.description: Loading vs ready — shows skeleton chrome + placeholder bars while `"loading"`. Default: `"ready"`.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Centered shimmer label while loading.

props.name: barGap
props.description: Gap between bar groups as a fraction of band width (0-1). Default: 0.2

props.name: barWidth
props.description: Fixed bar width in pixels. If not set, bars auto-size to fill the band.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Bar chart orientation. Default: "vertical"

props.name: stacked
props.description: Stack bars instead of grouping them. `true` stacks raw values; `"percent"` normalises each category to 100 % (value axis 0–100 %, a `YAxis` without its own format prints percent, `showValues` prints shares); `"diverging"` centres `divergingCenter` on the zero line with the series declared before it growing left/down and those after it right/up (Likert rows). Default: false

props.name: stackGap
props.description: Gap between stacked bar segments in pixels. Default: 0

props.name: divergingCenter
props.description: `stacked="diverging"`: the series straddling zero (e.g. `"Neutral"`). Unset: the series split in half.

props.description: Row order: by value (`"asc"`/`"desc"`, the stack total when stacked) or `{ by, dir }`. Default: `"none"`.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse the (sorted) row order. Default: false

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Gather rows by this column: horizontal bars get a bold header row per group, vertical columns a header above each group; groups are separated by a hairline and keep their own (sorted) order.

props.name: colorBy
props.description: Colour each bar by another column through `resolvePalette` (six hues, then the neutral ladder with a dev warning) and show a colour key. One key per chart (RM-118 R4): whenever this produces a non-empty colour key, the `legend` container legend below YIELDS and renders nothing — `colorBy`'s own key already covers the same job, and `interactive: "toggle"` has no effect in that mode (there is no container legend to press).

props.name: track
props.description: Paint a track behind each bar to the axis maximum ("to 100 %"). `true` uses `--chart-mono-2`, a mark-weight grey; `{ fill }` names another ink — a surface tone such as `var(--chart-segment-background)` when the track should read as paper, not as data. Default: false

props.name: overlays
props.description: Value markers and range spans drawn per bar on top of the series; listed in `legendItems`.

props.name: comparison
props.description: A muted prior-period column behind each main column (the main column narrows to make room).

props.name: comparisonLabel
props.description: Grey label beside each comparison pair. Default: `"none"`.

props.name: children
props.description: Child components (Bar, Grid, ChartTooltip, etc.)

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Reports reveal lifecycle for OG screenshots and loading orchestration.

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Drill-down (#349). Fires when a bar is activated by pointer OR keyboard. Setting it mounts a keyboard-operable target layer OUTSIDE the aria-hidden SVG — one tab stop, arrow keys to traverse. Unset changes nothing.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Put the datapoint's exact value on the clipboard when it is activated — the recovery path for a compact axis label. Default `false`; a chart with no interaction props still renders byte-identical DOM. A consumer-supplied `onDatapointClick` always wins.

props.name: datapointLabel
props.description: Override the accessible name of each keyboard drill-down target (#349).

props.name: maxInteractiveDatapoints
props.description: Dev-warning threshold on the number of keyboard targets. Default 500 (#349).

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. series names + value range).

props.name: palette
props.description: Default fill for `Bar` children that don't set their own `fill`, via `resolvePalette` (RM-018) over the series count — so, for example, nine unfilled `Bar` series degrade to the neutral ladder with a dev warning instead of nine bars painted identically. A `Bar` with an explicit `fill` is never touched. Default: `"categorical"` (`resolvePalette`'s own default) — but see `applyBarPalette`: it only ever assigns colours to SERIES THAT WOULD OTHERWISE COLLIDE (2+ unfilled `Bar` children), so a chart with a single unfilled `Bar` keeps today's `--chart-line-primary`.

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend engine (RM-118): `true` or a config object mounts `ChartLegend` beside the plot via `useContainerLegend`; `{ interactive: "toggle" }` turns each item into a real `aria-pressed` button that hides a series on grouped OR stacked bars — the value domain (`resolveBarValueDomain`, always zero-based) recomputes from the VISIBLE series only, and the hidden series' `<Bar>` never mounts, so it drops out of the datapoint layer too. `interactive: "hover"` (default) dims the other series via the existing `ChartLegendHoverProvider` seam `Bar` already reads. Unset renders NOTHING new (R1). Yields to `colorBy`'s own key — see its doc (R4, one key per chart).

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Overview strip style. Default `"none"`. `"miniChart"` / `"bar"` / `"auto"` mount it once the categories overflow `maxVisibleItems`.

props.name: maxVisibleItems
props.description: Categories the plot shows at once while scrolling (the strip's window). Default `"auto"`.

props.name: selectionGestures
props.description: Gestures to enable: `"range"` on an axis, `"rect"` / `"lasso"` on marks. Needs `onSelectionIntent`; unset, there is no gesture layer.

props.name: onSelectionIntent
props.description: Receives one `ChartSelectionIntent` (`field`, `values`, `mode`) per gesture — per ✓ in `explicit`.

props.name: selectionConfirm
props.description: `"immediate"` (default) or `"explicit"`: provisional paint, ✓ / Enter commit, ✕ / Esc cancel.

props.name: annotations
props.description: Declarative annotations in data units: text notes, ranges, reference lines, row notes.

props.name: analytics
props.description: Statistical overlays computed from `data` (ADR 0040 §1): computed `line`/`band`s (average, median, percentile, std-dev, CI) drawn through the annotation layer, and `trend`/`window`/`forecast`/`errorBars` drawn as derived series with a legend entry, a tooltip row and an accessible sentence. Unset: no change.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a hover/focus tooltip. Default `true`: with no `<ChartTooltip>` child the chart adds a default one; a `<ChartTooltip>` child (for `variant`, `rows`, `content`, …) replaces it. `false` turns the default off.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the tick labels sit. Default: `"bottom"`.

props.name: numTicks
props.description: About how many ticks to aim for. Default: 5, fewer when the plot is narrow.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the tick values print — a preset or a spec (`{ suffix: " h" }`). Default: `"compact"`.

props.name: title
props.description: A short name for the axis, printed after the last tick ("hours").

props.name: tickerHalfWidth
props.description: Width of the date ticker box for fade calculation. Default: 50

props.name: showAllLabels
props.description: Keep every category (never stride over labels). Default: false. NOTE this no longer forces HORIZONTAL rendering: with dropping disabled the axis may still tilt, ellipsize, or hide itself when the labels cannot fit.

props.name: maxLabels
props.description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 12

props.name: fit
props.description: How labels that do not fit their band are rescued (RM-108): - `"auto"` (default) — horizontal → two-line `wrap` → 45° tilt → ellipsis → stride → hidden; - `"wrap"` — the same cascade without the tilt rung (never rotates); - `"tilt"` — the pre-RM-108 cascade (skips `wrap`); - `"off"` — pins the pre-fit behaviour: full labels, count-capped stride, no measurement and no reserved axis space. The regression escape hatch.

props.name: showAllLabels
props.description: Keep every category (never stride over labels). Default: true. NOTE this no longer implies every label renders in full: the axis still ellipsizes to the gutter it has, and hides itself when nothing legible fits.

props.name: maxLabels
props.description: Maximum number of labels to show. Default: 20

props.name: fit
props.description: `"off"` pins the pre-fit behaviour — full labels, count-capped stride, no measurement and no reserved gutter. The regression escape hatch. Default: `"auto"`.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: The widest the label gutter may grow, in px. The gutter is measured from the labels and capped so a long name cannot eat the plot; the default cap suits one or two words. Raise it for rows whose names ARE the content — "Send Invoice → Payment Reminder" — and the chart still keeps its own minimum plot width. Default: 112.

props.name: value
props.description: The actual value — drawn as the bar.

props.name: target
props.description: The target — drawn as a tick, taller and darker than the bar.

props.name: comparative
props.description: A second reference (e.g. last year) — a small marker, a distinct shape from the target tick.

props.name: bands
props.description: Qualitative ranges (ascending `to`), drawn as 2–3 neutral steps behind the bar.

props.name: min
props.description: Scale floor. Default `0` — bars are zero-based; a caller-supplied negative floor is only honored when `value` itself is negative.

props.name: max
props.description: Scale ceiling. Default: the largest of `value`/`target`/`comparative`/the last band's `to`, "nice"-rounded with 5% headroom.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Bar direction. Default `"horizontal"`.

props.name: size
props.description: `"sm"` (default) is word-sized with no axis; `"md"` adds a hairline tick axis.

props.name: showAxis
props.description: Show the hairline tick axis. Default `size === "md"`.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the value/target/comparative numbers are formatted. Default `"compact"`, one notation shared across the whole scale.

props.name: labels
props.description: Caller-supplied names interpolated into the auto-generated accessible description.

props.name: higherIsBetter
props.description: Whether ASCENDING band values read better (default `true`). Bands are always drawn low→high by position (`to` is ascending), but which END is "worst" depends on the measure: a lower-is-better KPI (e.g. cost) has its worst band at the HIGH end. Flips which side of the shade ramp gets the darkest (worst) rung so the visual always reads poor→good in the metric's own good direction, never just left→right.

props.name: data
props.description: Long-format data — one row per (period, entity) pair.

props.name: period
props.description: Key in `data` for the discrete period (e.g. "Q1", "2026-W12").

props.name: entity
props.description: Key in `data` for the entity being ranked.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key in `data` for the entity's value that period. Ranks are derived from it when `rankKey` is absent.

props.name: rankKey
props.description: Key in `data` for an already-computed rank (1 = best). Takes priority over a derived rank when present.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"lines"` (default) — one line per entity on an inverted rank y-axis. `"strip"` — G21's fixed-row filmstrip: shade + a printed number carry the per-period rank instead of vertical position.

props.name: highlightKey
props.description: The hero entity — drawn in ink (`var(--chart-foreground)`) and bold; every other entity draws from the neutral mono ladder.

props.name: showDelta
props.description: Show a ▲n / ▼n delta flag (rank movement into the LAST period) per row. Default `false`.

props.name: maxEntities
props.description: Cap on plotted entities, kept by final rank. Default `10`; dev-warns once when the data has more. For `variant="strip"` this is also intersected with the largest row count whose printed rank still fits legibly (#273) — a raised `maxEntities` that would no longer fit is quietly lowered and warned about by name, never silently dropped to colour-only.

props.name: maxPeriods
props.description: `variant="strip"` only: cap on plotted periods (columns), kept as the MOST RECENT N — a rank race reads right-to-left, so the oldest periods are the meaningful ones to drop. Defaults to the largest column count whose printed rank still reaches the legibility floor for the chart's current width; dev-warns once naming `maxPeriods` when data (or an explicit value) would cross it (#273). Ignored by `"lines"`.

props.name: palette
props.description: Which colour family the `"strip"` cell shade draws from. Default `"sequential"` (rank 1 = most ink). Ignored by `"lines"`, which always draws hero-ink + mono.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How the tooltip's raw value cell is formatted. Default `"compact"`.

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as `"width / height"`. Default `"2 / 1"`.

props.name: plotHeight

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. entity count + period range).

props.name: positiveFill

props.name: negativeFill

props.name: bodyPatternPositive
props.description: Optional pattern URL for body only (e.g. url(#pattern)). When set, body is drawn solid first, then pattern overlaid and masked to the body rect.

props.name: bodyPatternNegative
props.description: Optional pattern URL for negative candle body.

props.name: insideStrokeWidth

props.name: fadedOpacity

props.name: enterTransition
props.description: Motion enter transition (spring or cubic-bezier tween).

props.name: revealSignature
props.description: Signature of motion URL state — triggers enter replay when it changes.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as "width / height". Default: "2 / 1"

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the container (e.g. { height: 320 })

props.name: candleGap
props.description: Gap between candles as fraction of slot width (0–1). Default: 0.2. Ignored when candleWidth is set.

props.name: candleWidth
props.description: Fixed candle body width in pixels. If set, overrides candleGap.

props.name: xDomain
props.description: When set, xScale uses this domain instead of deriving from data. Use with brush so main chart and strip share the same scale.

props.name: xDomainSlotCount
props.description: When xDomain is set, use this as the number of slots for scale padding (e.g. full data length).

props.name: children
props.description: Child components (Candlestick, Grid, XAxis, YAxis, ChartTooltip, etc.)

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. symbol name + date range).

props.name: analytics
props.description: Statistical overlays computed from the closes (RM-138 / RM-139, ADR 0040 §1): a moving average (`{ kind: "window", k: 20 }`, `reduce: "ewm"` for an EMA), a trend, or a computed line/band. Unset: no change.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Overview strip: `"none"` (default), `"miniChart"`, `"bar"`, or `"auto"` — the strip appears only once the rows overflow `maxVisiblePoints`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a hover/focus tooltip. Default `true`: with no `<ChartTooltip>` child the chart adds a default one; a `<ChartTooltip>` child (for `variant`, `rows`, `content`, …) replaces it. `false` turns the default off.

props.name: selectionMark
props.description: Selection gestures (RM-144): where a datum sits (CSS px inside the layer) and the category it selects. Required for `selectionGestures` to mount — it is how the canvas marks enter the selection engine's registry.

props.name: selectionAxes
props.description: The data axes behind `selectionMark`'s pixels, so intents carry data units.

props.name: points
props.description: The marks, in the order the keyboard cursor walks them. This layer never renders one element per point — the array is the cursor's index space, and the source of the mark count.

props.name: draw
props.type: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, scales: ChartScales, dpr: number) => void
props.description: Paints one frame into a `dpr`-transformed, already-cleared context, in CSS pixels. Read colours with `canvasTokenColor`, never a literal — the layer redraws on theme change, which only helps if the callback re-reads tokens.

props.name: hitTest
props.description: Nearest datum to a CSS-pixel position inside the layer, or `null`. Back it with `createSpatialGrid`, not a linear scan.

props.name: onDatapointFocus
props.description: Fires when the KEYBOARD cursor lands on a datum, and with `null` on blur.

props.name: onDatapointHover
props.description: Fires when the POINTER moves onto, or off, a datum.

props.name: onDatapointActivate
props.description: Fires on a click over a mark, or Enter/Space on the keyboard cursor.

props.name: focusRect
props.description: Where the focus ring goes for a datum, in CSS pixels. Omit it and the ring frames the whole layer instead — focus stays visible either way.

props.name: labelFor
props.description: Spoken text for one datum. Without it the cursor announces nothing useful.

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: Tooltip body for the hovered/focused datum. Omit for no tooltip.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in CSS pixels. Omitted → measured from the element.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height in CSS pixels. Omitted → measured from the element.

props.name: margin
props.description: Plot insets passed through to `draw`. Defaults to zero on every side.

props.name: drawSignature
props.description: Changes when the data behind `draw` changes; triggers a repaint.

props.name: animateIn
props.description: Ramp `scales.progress` 0→1 on mount. Ignored under reduced motion.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the mark region and its keyboard cursor.

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: The parallel summary — what the marks convey, in words. This is the channel that replaces what AT loses when marks stop being DOM elements. Write it like a chart caption ("50,000 events across 12 case rows, March to June; density peaks mid-April"), not like a data dump.

props.name: annotations
props.description: The annotations, in reading order (the narrow key numbers them in this order).

props.name: layer
props.description: `back` paints ranges (behind the marks), `front` paints lines, rows, notes and narrow markers (over the marks), `all` paints both in place. A chart shell that finds this layer among its children paints it twice, `back` first and `front` over the series, so a consumer never sets this.

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: Value axis the `y` positions resolve against. Default: the primary axis.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Callback when brush selection ends. Domain is the selected time range.

props.name: brushDirection
props.description: Brush direction. Default: "horizontal" for time range selection.

props.name: selectedBoxStyle
props.description: Fill style for the selected region. Default: chart segment style.

props.name: initialSelection
props.description: Initial selection so the brush overlay is visible on load (e.g. first 50% of range).

props.name: selection
props.description: Current selection (e.g. from parent state). When set, a visible selection rect is drawn.

props.name: useWindowMoveEvents
props.description: Use window move events for brush (can fix coordinate offset when SVG is in transformed container). Default: true for brush-in-strip.

props.name: blurPx
props.description: Backdrop blur on dimmed track (0–5 px). Default: 1.5

props.name: fadeOuterEdges
props.description: Fade dimmed regions at the outer track edges. Default: true

props.name: selectionPattern
props.description: Optional pattern overlay inside the brush selection window.

props.name: data
props.description: Full dataset backing the brush strip and main chart.

props.name: enabled
props.description: When false, children render without brush zoom state.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height of the brush strip in pixels.

props.name: brushStrip
props.description: Mini chart + brush handles rendered below the main chart when `enabled`.

props.name: selectionX0
props.description: Pixel x of the selection start within the plot area.

props.name: selectionX1
props.description: Pixel x of the selection end within the plot area.

props.name: title
props.description: Write the title as the CONCLUSION, not the chart type — "Revenue is up 8% QoQ", not "Revenue chart". Put what each series means in prose in `description` (lieflat's card contract).

props.name: titleAs
props.description: Heading level for the card's title, forwarded to `CardTitle`'s own `as` prop (#328). Set this when the card titles a real page section so it contributes to the document outline. @default "div"

props.name: description
props.description: Prose that IS the legend — what a reader needs to read the chart correctly (series, units, scope), written as a sentence, not a caption.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header actions (range picker, menu).

props.name: children
props.description: The chart itself. Bring your own chart lib (Recharts, visx, etc.).

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed body height so charts have a sizing context. Defaults to 260.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading vs ready — the body becomes a layout-shaped skeleton at the same height; title/description keep rendering. Default: `false`.

props.name: source
props.description: Attribution / provenance footer — e.g. "Source: Internal analytics, updated daily". Renders as the card's all-caps, letter-spaced source row (the fourth part of lieflat's card contract); hidden when absent. A string that overflows the row stays fully recoverable — a native `title` and, once it measurably overflows, a keyboard-reachable tooltip (#184). A non-string node keeps only the CSS caps with no overflow recovery — keep it short, or accept it may be visually truncated with no fallback.

props.name: value
props.type: Partial<Omit<ChartConfigValue, "interactions" | "density" | "densityByBreakpoint">> & { interactions?: ChartInteractions; /** * Furniture tier, optionally per breakpoint. An explicit `narrow` entry * (`{ base: "md", narrow: "md" }`) keeps the legend and value axis on a * narrow chart — the per-chart escape hatch from the narrow → `sm` coupling. */ density?: Responsive<ChartDensity>; }
props.description: Partial overrides. `interactions` may itself be partial — missing keys keep their defaults (`edit: false`, the rest `true`).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the target group. Defaults to a localized generic name.

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Consumer drill-down handler. Optional so `copyValueOnActivate` can stand alone.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Copy the datapoint's exact value when it is activated and no handler is set.

props.name: title
props.description: Write the title as the CONCLUSION, not the chart type — "Revenue is up 8% QoQ", not "Revenue chart". Put what each series means in prose in `description` (lieflat's card contract).

props.name: description
props.description: Prose that IS the legend — what a reader needs to read the chart correctly (series, units, scope), written as a sentence, not a caption. Bold the finding with `<strong>`; colour-key a series in the prose with `<InlineChip series="ram">short-term RAM</InlineChip>` — the chip takes the series' colour from the chart inside this frame, and its accessible name is the series name (RM-117).

props.name: notes
props.description: Notes under the chart (RM-117): method, definitions, caveats. Italic, above the footer; part of an exported picture.

props.name: byline
props.description: "Chart: Author" at the start of the footer (RM-117). `kind` picks the word.

props.name: altText
props.description: Text alternative for the whole picture (RM-117) — Datawrapper's "alt text". Becomes the chart figure's `aria-describedby` content when the chart has no description of its own; with no chart figure, the frame body becomes the figure it describes.

props.name: actions
props.description: Footer links (RM-117), always drawn in Datawrapper's order: `"data"` (Get the data → CSV), your own nodes (an Embed link), `"svg"`, `"png"` (Download image). Built-ins degrade like the toolbar: no data → no `"data"`, no `<svg>` → no image links. Never part of an exported picture.

props.name: footerLabels

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The chart's own drawing height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. The title, legend, notes and source row are added AROUND it, so the frame is as tall as its content. Unset: the chart's family default (2 : 1, and 1.25 : 1 when narrow, for line/bar/…). With `chrome="tile"` and neither `plotHeight` nor `height`, the chart fills the tile's remaining height instead (#444). `plotHeight={260}` keeps the pre-ADR-0039 look of a card.

props.name: height
props.description: @deprecated Use `plotHeight` — it sets the chart's own height, and the title, legend and notes are added around it. `height={n}` is now an alias for `plotHeight={n}` (it no longer fixes the body); removed in 6.0.0.

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading vs ready — renders a layout-shaped skeleton at the normal body height and suppresses the expand/flip-to-table/download toolbar (meaningless with no data yet). Default: `false`.

props.name: renderTable
props.description: Custom table renderer for the flip-to-table view. Defaults to the @elabs-ai/components-ui Table primitive.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Custom CSV download handler. Defaults to the local RFC-4180 serializer (injection-guarded). The canonical reusable version is @elabs-ai/components-data `toCsv`; wire it here, or use the `chart-frame-data` registry block (`npx shadcn add chart-frame-data`) for the full sortable DataTable + downloadCsv.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Routes an SVG/PNG export to the caller — with the generated `Blob` and filename — instead of triggering a local browser download. Mirrors `onDownload`, for apps that want to route an export through their own storage. When absent, the built-in handler downloads the file directly.

props.name: source
props.description: Attribution / provenance footer — e.g. "Source: Internal analytics, updated daily". Renders as the card's all-caps, letter-spaced source row (the fourth part of lieflat's card contract) inline and in the expand modal, under the chart in both — never appended to the summary statistics; when it is a plain string it also lands as a trailing `# source: …` comment row in the downloaded CSV, and as a bottom row in an SVG/PNG export. Hidden when absent. A string that overflows the row stays fully recoverable — a native `title` and, once it measurably overflows, a keyboard-reachable tooltip (#184). A non-string node keeps only the CSS caps with no overflow recovery — keep it short, or accept it may be visually truncated with no fallback. RM-117: `{ name, href }` names and links the source. With that form, a `byline` or `actions`, the source joins the footer row as "Source: Name" instead of the all-caps row.

props.name: chrome
props.description: Surface drawn around the chart (RM-072). Default `"card"` — byte-identical to a frame without the prop. See `ChartFrameChrome`.

props.name: titleSize
props.description: How loud the title is. `"default"` is a card title inside a dashboard — one of many. `"headline"` is a published figure standing on its own: the title takes the `text-title` role and balances its lines, and the description steps up to body size in the foreground ink, because in a standalone figure the description is reading text, not a caption.

props.name: headerSlot
props.description: `chrome="tile"` only: replaces the default title/description header.

props.name: menuSlot
props.description: `chrome="tile"` only: replaces the inline toolbar. A function receives the frame's actions, so a host kebab menu can open the expand modal, flip to the table or export without reaching into context.

props.name: onExpandChange
props.description: Fires when the expand modal opens or closes, however it was triggered.

props.name: interactions
props.description: Which interaction layers the chart mounts (`passive` tooltips, `active` brush/datapoint targets, `select` datapoint activation, `edit`). Defaults: all `true` except `edit: false`. Forwarded to every chart family through `useChartConfig()`.

props.name: selection
props.description: Selection chrome defaults for the framed chart (RM-145). A chart listing `selectionGestures` puts its `ChartSelectionToolbar` in the frame's action row; `toolbar: "none"` keeps it out, and `confirm` sets the chart's default `selectionConfirm` (a brand theme modelled on the associative suite asks for `"explicit"`). The chart's own props always win.

props.name: density
props.description: Furniture tier (`"xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg"`, default `"md"`). Forwarded to every chart family through `useChartConfig()`; the frame itself drops `description` and the source row at `xs` and clamps the title to one line at `xs`/`sm`. Optionally per breakpoint (ADR 0039): inside a `narrow` chart `md`/`lg` become `sm` unless an explicit `narrow` entry says otherwise (`{ base: "md", narrow: "md" }` keeps the legend and value axis).

props.name: children
props.description: The chart content. Rendered in both inline and expanded modal positions.

props.name: items
props.description: Legend items to display

props.name: hoveredIndex
props.description: Currently hovered index (for highlight effect)

props.name: onHover
props.description: Callback when an item is hovered

props.name: onItemClick
props.type: ( item: LegendItem, index: number, event: React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent, ) => void
props.description: Drill-down on a legend entry (#349). When set, each item renders as a real `<button>` — keyboard operable and named by the item's label — instead of a `<div>`. Unset, the legend is unchanged (a non-interactive `<div>` list). NOTE this lives on `ChartLegend`, not on the chart containers: the legend is a separately-placed composition primitive, so a callback on the container would be a prop the container cannot honour.

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Series toggle (RM-118, `legend={{ interactive: "toggle" }}`). Set together with `onToggleKey`: every item renders as a real `<button aria-pressed>` — native keyboard support, no extra wiring — and `hiddenKeys` marks which ones read `aria-pressed="false"` and paint dimmed with a struck-through label (WCAG 1.4.1: hidden is never colour-only). Independent of `onItemClick` (drill-down); a container sets one or the other.

props.name: onToggleKey
props.type: (key: string, item: LegendItem, index: number) => void
props.description: Toggles one item's hidden state. Keyed by `item.key ?? item.label`.

props.name: hideAtDensity
props.description: Density tiers that hide the whole legend (RM-072 default: `xs`/`sm`). The container legend engine (`useContainerLegend`, RM-118) passes `["xs"]` — `sm` renders `stack`-laid-out instead of hiding — so this stays `["xs", "sm"]` for every OTHER (direct) caller, unchanged.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Show progress bars. Default: false

props.name: showMarker
props.description: Show color marker dot. Default: true

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show numeric value column. Default: true

props.name: showPercentage
props.description: Show percentage value. Default: true when showProgress is true

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Format function for displaying values. Overrides `valueFormat` entirely when set.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How to format `value`/`maxValue` (RM-109) — a preset or the object form (`{ decimals, abbreviate, sign, prefix, suffix, … }`, `value-format.ts`). Resolved as a SET across every item (#250, `useChartValueSetFormatter`) so the legend never mixes "1K" beside "400". Default: locale-aware plain grouping (`intFmt`), unchanged from before this prop existed.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for `valueFormat: "currency"`. Falls back to `ChartConfigProvider`, then `"USD"`.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown above the legend

props.name: layout
props.description: Item flow direction (RM-118, sitting 3). `"stack"` (default — every caller before this prop existed) is byte-identical to before: one item per line. `"row"` wraps items left-to-right (`flex-wrap`), matching the layout `AutoChart`'s old `AutoLegend` used, AND drops the `w-full` an interactive (`onItemClick`/toggle) item otherwise gets — `w-full` inside a row would force every item onto its own line regardless of this prop. `useContainerLegend` (the container legend engine) passes its own resolved `layout` ("row" at `base`/`medium`/`wide`, "stack" at `narrow` or density `sm`) through; a direct caller may set its own or leave it unset for the original stacked behaviour.

props.name: splitStacked
props.description: Stack the split rows vertically (the narrow tier). Default `false`: side by side, wrapping.

props.name: text

props.name: showLines
props.description: Whether to show vertical guide lines. Default: true

props.name: animate
props.description: Whether to animate markers on entrance. Default: true

props.name: store
props.description: An external store; one is created per provider when omitted.

props.name: data
props.description: Long rows, split into panels by `by`. Ignored when `panels` is set.

props.name: by
props.description: A column key (one panel per value), or `{ series: true }` — one panel per `dataKeys` entry over the same rows (split bars).

props.name: panels
props.description: Explicit panels (instead of `data` + `by`).

props.name: xDataKey
props.description: Row key of the x value (hover lookup, shared x extent, baseline join).

props.name: dataKeys
props.description: Row keys of the plotted values; the first drives sort, stats and the hovered value.

props.name: columns
props.description: Panels per row, per breakpoint. Default `{ base: "auto", narrow: 1 }`.

props.name: minPanelWidth
props.description: Minimum panel width `columns: "auto"` packs to. Default 240.

props.name: panelHeight
props.description: Each panel's plot height (px or `{ aspect }`), per breakpoint. Default 200.

props.name: sort
props.description: Panel order. Default `"data"` (input order). Numeric keys sort largest first.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverse the sort order.

props.name: baseline
props.description: A series drawn muted behind every panel's own series: a panel `key` (removed from the grid) or a row `series` key.

props.name: showAt
props.description: Per-panel visibility, per breakpoint (a panel's own `showAt` wins).

props.name: syncHover
props.description: Synced hover: every panel shows the crosshair at the hovered category and `panelTitle` receives the hovered value. Line, Area and Composed panels only; bar and pie panels get the shared layout and domains. Default `true`.

props.name: panelTitle
props.description: Title slot; `hovered` is set while any panel is hovered (value-in-title).

props.name: annotations
props.description: Annotations; `panel` names one panel, `"all"`/unset repeats it in every panel.

props.name: children
props.description: Renders one panel's chart.

props.name: revealEpoch
props.description: Bumps when motion settings change to replay the reveal.

props.name: padding
props.description: Extra inset around the clip rect so edge glyphs are not cut off.

props.name: animating
props.description: When false, clip stays at full width (no grow animation).

props.name: mode
props.description: Reveal grows 0 → full; conceal shrinks full → 0 (ready → loading).

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called when a conceal animation finishes.

props.name: revealOn
props.description: When the enter reveal (`mode="reveal"` only) is allowed to play. `"mount"` (default) is byte-identical to pre-RM-020 behaviour — it plays as soon as this component renders. `"inView"` holds the clip at width 0 (series fully hidden, nothing animating) until `viewportRef`'s element scrolls to `amount: 0.3` in the viewport, then plays once. Requires `viewportRef` — without one this degrades to `"mount"` (with a dev-only console warning) rather than silently never revealing.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Element observed for `revealOn="inView"`, and — when `replayOnClick` is set — listened to for replay clicks. Typically the chart's outer container (`ChartContextValue.containerRef`).

props.name: replayOnClick
props.description: Clicking `viewportRef`'s element replays the enter reveal. Default `false`. Pass `shouldReplayOnClick` to ignore clicks that already mean something else (e.g. a datapoint activation) — this option exists precisely so a caller can guarantee `replayOnClick` never swallows `onDatapointClick`; with no predicate every click on the element replays. **Pointer-only by construction — always pair it with `replayCount` (#176).** `viewportRef` is an element chosen for intersection OBSERVATION, not a control: it has no role, no accessible name and no tab stop, and it usually wraps an `aria-hidden` chart body where adding `tabIndex` would be the axe `aria-hidden-focus` violation. So this option cannot carry the keyboard path itself. Whenever you enable it, also render a real `<button>` OUTSIDE the chart body that bumps `replayCount` — a replay affordance a keyboard user cannot reach is a WCAG 2.1.1 failure. See `Charts/Reveal/InView` → `ReplayOnClick` for the reference wiring.

props.name: shouldReplayOnClick
props.description: Return `false` to ignore a click for replay purposes.

props.name: replayCount
props.description: Caller-driven replay signal — the KEYBOARD half of `replayOnClick`. Default `0`. Bump it from a real, focusable control you render outside the (`aria-hidden`) chart body: `<button type="button" onClick={() => setReplays((n) => n + 1)}>Replay reveal</button>`. A `<button>` is activated by both Enter and Space for free, so no key handling is needed and no `tabIndex` lands inside the chart. It goes through the SAME internal replay counter as a pointer click, so it replays identically and releases a `revealOn="inView"` hold identically — the keyboard path is equivalent to the mouse path, not a lesser one. `shouldReplayOnClick` does not apply: that predicate protects a chart body's own click handling, while a dedicated control unambiguously means "replay".

props.name: onEnterPlay
props.description: Fires each time the enter reveal actually starts playing — on mount (`revealOn="mount"`, or immediately if `viewportRef` is already in view), the first time `viewportRef` scrolls into view, and on every replay (`revealEpoch` bump, `replayOnClick`, or a `replayCount` bump). Never fires for `mode="conceal"` or while `animating` is false. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it still fires — the reveal "plays", it just lands on its finished state in one frame — so the observability contract is identical on both motion paths. Exists for observability (tests, a `Charts/Reveal/InView` story) — nothing in the component depends on it.

props.name: xDataKey
props.description: The chart's `xDataKey` — the intent's `field` unless `selectionField` overrides it.

props.name: margin
props.type: { left: number; bottom: number; top?: number; right?: number }
props.description: Plot margins: the axis gutters a `range` gesture listens on, and the host offset.

props.name: field

props.description: A heatmap's row field — a row range reports it.

props.name: marks
props.description: The family's marks, in plot pixels (memoised).

props.name: margin
props.type: { top: number; left: number; bottom: number }
props.description: Plot origin inside the host (the family's margin).

props.name: rangeAxes
props.description: Which axis gutters arm a range (still gated by `"range"` in the scope).

props.name: areaEnabled
props.description: In-plot area gestures (rect / lasso / radial / keyboard rectangle). Default `true`.

props.name: of
props.description: The series a measure-axis range reads (the intent's `gesture.of`).

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Axis names spoken by the range thumbs.

props.name: formatValue
props.type: { x?: (value: number) => string; y?: (value: number) => string }
props.description: Formats a linear axis value for bubbles / thumbs.

props.name: getEventTarget
props.description: The element pointer listeners bind on, found from the layer's own `<g>` (a DOM walk — an ancestor's React ref is not attached yet when the layer binds). Default: the layer's parent (the plot `<g>`).

props.name: session
props.description: The session to drive. Default: the nearest gesture-enabled container's.

props.name: showDatePill
props.description: Whether to show the date pill at bottom. Default: true

props.name: showCrosshair
props.description: Whether to show the vertical crosshair line. Default: true

props.name: showDots
props.description: Whether to show dots on the lines. Default: true

props.name: indicatorColor
props.description: Color for the crosshair/indicator line. When a function, receives the hovered point (e.g. for candlestick: match candle color from close vs open). Default: --chart-crosshair.

props.name: content
props.type: (props: { point: Record<string, unknown>; index: number }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Custom content renderer for the tooltip box

props.name: rows
props.description: Custom row renderer - return array of TooltipRow

props.name: variant
props.description: Box layout preset (RM-119). `"rows"` (default) is today's stacked `ChartTooltipContent`. `"table"` renders `ChartTooltipTable` — one column per series with a header row, the date in the `<caption>` (Datawrapper's dual-axis / multi-series shape, `dw-charts.md` §2.22). `"inline"` renders no box at all — `ChartTooltipInline` paints the hovered (or `focus`-nearest) series' value directly at the mark with `HaloText` (the bikes chart). Ignored when `content` is set — a custom renderer already owns the whole box.

props.name: focus
props.description: Drive RM-112's per-series dim (`SeriesHoverDim`) from the tooltip's OWN nearest-series resolution: whichever series' y position is closest to the pointer, at ANY x along the crosshair, counts as hovered — not only a direct hover on that series' own 2px stroke. Works standalone: it registers "focus requested" on the shared series-mode context, so the dim fires with no `focusOnHover` prop on the `LineChart`/`AreaChart` container (a container `focusOnHover` still works exactly as before, and the two compose — either one turns the dim on). Also the default target series for `variant="inline"`. Default false.

props.name: pin
props.description: Tap-to-pin (RM-119): on a coarse pointer, a tap keeps the tooltip open instead of clearing the instant the finger lifts. A second tap on the mark, `Esc`, or a tap outside the chart releases it (announced once via `role="status" aria-live="polite"`). Default: `true` only when the pointer is coarse (`(pointer: coarse)` media query); pass an explicit boolean to force either way regardless of pointer type.

props.name: valueInTitle
props.description: Swap the tooltip box's own title for nothing — the hovered value moves to the chart's OWN title instead (RM-119, #610). Inside a `ChartFrame` that shows a title this is automatic: while a row is hovered, pinned or keyboard-focused the frame's title reads "Apr: Revenue 40" and is announced once through the frame's polite status; leaving restores the title. No wiring. Outside a frame (or in `chrome="bare"`, a custom `headerSlot`, the expanded dialog) only the box title is dropped — the date/category is still on `useChart().tooltipData` for a custom title. Default false.

props.name: dotColor
props.type: string | ((point: Record<string, unknown>, line: LineConfig) => string)
props.description: Override tooltip dot fill. When omitted and `rows` is set, dot colors match row colors. When a function, receives the hovered point and line config.

Set automatically from the chart's own `<YAxis unit>` when unset (the shell threads it through); pass it explicitly only to override. Ignored when `rows` is set — a custom row builder owns its own `TooltipRow.unit` per row.

props.name: yDomainTweenDuration

props.name: plotHeight

Default `true` — a point scale centres the end columns ON the plot edges and hangs half of each one outside it (a-3). Pass `false` for that older, overhanging geometry.

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Drill-down (#349). Fires when a datapoint is activated by pointer OR keyboard. Setting it mounts a keyboard-operable target layer OUTSIDE the aria-hidden SVG — one tab stop, arrow keys to traverse. Leaving it unset changes nothing: no extra DOM, no new focusables.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Put the datapoint's exact value on the clipboard when it is activated — the recovery path for a compact axis label. Default `false`; a chart with no interaction props still renders byte-identical DOM. A consumer-supplied `onDatapointClick` always wins.

props.name: datapointLabel

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. series names + value range).

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend engine (RM-118): `true` or a config object mounts `ChartLegend` beside the plot via `useContainerLegend`; `{ interactive: "toggle" }` hides a series and re-tweens the y-domain. Unset (default) renders NOTHING new — same R1 as `LineChart`/`AreaChart`.

props.name: yAxes
props.description: Two value axes (RM-121). Set it, give each series a `yAxisId` (`SeriesBar` draws on the primary `"left"` axis) and place both `YAxis` as direct children: `align: "ticks"` (default) gives both axes one tick count on the same pixel rows, `proportional` makes them grow by the same factor, and `zero` applies the "both or neither" baseline rule. Columns and areas stay zero-based whatever is asked (`charts-honesty`). Both axes stay visible at the narrow tier. Unset: every axis is independent, as before.

props.name: annotations
props.description: Declarative annotations in data units: text notes, ranges, reference lines, row notes.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description: Overview strip: `"none"` (default), `"miniChart"`, `"bar"`, or `"auto"` — the strip appears only once the rows overflow `maxVisiblePoints` (time x) / `maxVisibleItems` (band x).

props.name: selectionGestures
props.description: Gestures to enable: `"range"` on an axis, `"rect"` / `"lasso"` on marks. Needs `onSelectionIntent`; unset, there is no gesture layer.

props.name: onSelectionIntent

props.name: selectionConfirm
props.description: `"immediate"` (default) or `"explicit"`: provisional paint, ✓ / Enter commit, ✕ / Esc cancel.

props.name: analytics
props.description: Statistical overlays computed from `data` (ADR 0040 §1): computed `line`/`band`s (average, median, percentile, std-dev, CI) drawn through the annotation layer, and `trend`/`window`/`forecast`/`errorBars` drawn as derived series with a legend entry, a tooltip row and an accessible sentence. Unset: no change.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a hover/focus tooltip. Default `true`: with no `<ChartTooltip>` child the chart adds a default one; a `<ChartTooltip>` child (for `variant`, `rows`, `content`, …) replaces it. `false` turns the default off.

props.name: yAxisId
props.description: The y-axis these shapes' `y` values belong to when a chart has several.

props.name: data
props.description: Columnar (preferred past ~50k) or rows.

props.name: xKey
props.description: Row key for x when `data` is rows. Default `"x"`. Also the intent `field` for x ranges.

props.name: yKey
props.description: Row key for y when `data` is rows. Default `"y"`.

props.name: valueKeys

props.name: categoryKeys
props.description: Row keys lifted as categorical columns (rows input only).

props.name: zones
props.description: Zones on the axes, inner → outer.

props.name: outside
props.description: Label/colour for points matching no zone.

props.name: colorBy
props.description: What colours the dots. Default `{ kind: "zone" }` (or `"density"` without zones).

props.name: valueKey
props.description: The value column whose cell mean the tooltip reports (a `colorBy: value` uses its own key). Unset: no mean row.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Bin size in CSS px. Default 5. Smaller = finer colour field, more cells.

props.name: underlay
props.description: Underlay threshold (points per cell) — a faint body under dense areas. `0` turns it off. Default 4.

props.name: pointRadius
props.description: Dot radius in CSS px at the home view; grows slightly with zoom. Default 1.35.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Wheel zoom + drag pan. Default `true`.

props.name: domain
props.description: The full-data window. Default: the data extent padded 3%.

props.name: selectionGestures
props.description: Gestures to enable (ADR 0040). `"range"`: drag on an axis gutter (one axis), or — with the toolbar's Range tool — a drag in the plot that sets the x AND the y range at once; keyboard: `role="slider"` thumbs in each gutter. `"lasso"`: the toolbar's Lasso tool, freehand in the plot. The toolbar (`ChartSelectionToolbar`: Pointer / Range / Lasso) mounts above the plot, or in `ChartFrame`'s action slot when framed. Unset: no gesture layer, no toolbar, DOM byte-identical.

props.name: onSelectionIntent
props.description: Fires one intent per committed gesture.

props.name: selectionField
props.description: Field name carried in x-range intents. Default `xKey`.

props.name: selectionFieldY
props.description: Y-range intents carry this field. Default `yKey`.

props.name: selectionToolbar
props.description: `"auto"` (default): the toolbar shows when gestures are listed; `"none"` hides it.

props.name: legend
props.description: Container legend (RM-118). `true` → `{ interactive: "toggle" }`.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Axis titles.

props.name: onFrame
props.description: Per-frame statistics (stories, diagnostics).

props.name: renderer
props.description: Force the Canvas-2D path (tests, screenshots).

props.name: hiddenKeys
props.description: Hidden classes, controlled. Keys are zone ids / category labels.

props.name: data
props.description: RECORD-level rows — one per observation, NOT pre-aggregated buckets. The container does the aggregating; handing it counts defeats the point.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: The numeric column. Rows whose value is not finite are dropped, and counted.

props.name: groupKey
props.description: The grouping column. Omit for a single, ungrouped distribution.

props.name: kind
props.description: Which mark to draw. See the table in this file's header for how to pick.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which screen axis the VALUE runs along. `"horizontal"` (default) puts groups in rows, which is what long group labels want; `"vertical"` puts them in columns.

props.name: bins
props.description: Histogram only: a bin COUNT hint (nice, approximate) or the FULL ordered edge list. Edges must be meaningful — a value outside an explicit list is dropped with a dev warning rather than absorbed by an end bucket. See `bins.ts`.

props.name: bandwidth
props.description: Violin only: KDE bandwidth. Unset uses Silverman's rule of thumb.

props.name: showMedian
props.description: Draw the median: a dashed flag on a histogram, a paper tick on a box/violin. Default `true`.

props.name: showOutliers
props.description: Box only: hollow marks beyond 1.5 × IQR. Default `true`.

props.name: unit
props.description: Histogram only: records per rung. Set it to draw each bin as COUNTABLE rungs (`F14`) instead of a bar — the number is the legend ("one rung = 5 tickets"), which is why it is a count and not a boolean.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Histogram with `unit` only: the legend that makes the rungs decodable — "one rung = 5 tickets". Rendered as a caption under the plot and folded into the accessible description. Ignored without `unit`.

props.name: palette
props.description: Colour family. With `"sequential"`, a box/violin's shade is its MEDIAN RANK — the darkest group has the highest median — so the ordering is carried by the fill as well as by position.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: Value formatting for ticks, tooltips and the text summary.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code when `valueFormat="currency"`.

props.name: referenceLines
props.description: Fixed thresholds drawn across the shared value axis (an SLA, a spec limit, a target) — dashed `--chart-foreground`, haloed so it stays legible over a box/violin body. Each labelled line's fact is folded into the chart's own accessible description, so it is never colour-only or visual-only. Default none — omitting it renders byte-identical to before this prop existed.

props.name: analytics
props.description: Computed lines and bands on the value axis (RM-138, ADR 0040 §1): an average, a percentile, `{ spread: { ci: 0.95 } }`, `{ spread: { stddev: 1 } }` … over `valueKey`, drawn like `referenceLines` and restated in the accessible description. Unset: no change.

props.name: selectionGestures
props.description: Gestures to enable: `"range"` on an axis, `"rect"` / `"lasso"` on marks. Needs `onSelectionIntent`; unset, there is no gesture layer.

props.name: onSelectionIntent
props.description: Receives one `ChartSelectionIntent` (`field`, `values`, `mode`) per gesture — per ✓ in `explicit`.

props.name: selectionConfirm
props.description: `"immediate"` (default) or `"explicit"`: provisional paint, ✓ / Enter commit, ✕ / Esc cancel.

props.name: duration
props.description: Draw duration in seconds (default 0.9).

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before drawing starts, in seconds — pair it with `stagger(i, …)`.

props.name: transition
props.description: Full transition override. Wins over `duration`/`delay`.

props.name: data
props.description: Data array — one row per category.

props.name: category
props.description: Key in `data` for the category label.

props.name: startKey
props.description: Key in `data` for the "before" value.

props.name: endKey
props.description: Key in `data` for the "after" value.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Rows (default) or columns. Ignored by `variant="slope"`, which is always two columns.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dumbbell"` (default, one track per category) or `"slope"` (two columns, one line per category).

props.name: beads
props.description: F12: draws a countable `UnitStack` between the two markers — one dot per `unit` of `|end - start|`, seeded jitter so each row draws differently. Ignored by `variant="slope"`.

props.name: markers
props.description: Marker fill style. Default `{ start: "hollow", end: "filled" }` (the F12 "before/after" read).

props.name: extraKeys
props.description: Extra numeric keys (e.g. competitor values) drawn as small dots on the same track. Ignored by `variant="slope"`.

props.name: valueKeys
props.description: `variant="dots"` only: N numeric keys drawn as one dot per key on the shared value axis, instead of the two-marker `start`/`end` read — `startKey`/`endKey` still name the first/last of them (for the domain and the optional `range` bar), and any keys between are the "extra" dots.

props.name: range
props.description: `variant="dots"` only: draws a bar between the row's lowest and highest dot. Default `false`.

props.name: keyColors
props.description: `variant="dots"` only: pin a value key to a colour (`{ Target: "var(--chart-mono-2)" }`) — dots and the colour key follow. Keys left out keep their palette colour. Default: none.

props.name: arrowWidth
props.description: `variant="arrow"` only: the arrow head's base width in px. Default `8`.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Buckets rows by this column, rendering a header + separator before each group (same shape as `BarChart`'s `groupBy`, RM-113/RM-116). Groups keep each row's resolved sort order; group order is first-seen in that same order. Unset (default) draws no headers — byte-identical to today.

props.name: showDelta
props.description: Show a signed delta label (`HaloText`) at the end marker. Default `false`. Superseded by `delta` when set.

props.name: deltaLabelFormat
props.description: Custom formatter for the `showDelta` label — receives the signed delta and its row, returns the full string (including sign/unit). Unset (default) keeps today's rendering: a bare `"+"` prefix on non-negative deltas ahead of `formatValue(delta)`. Use this when a delta needs a unit suffix (e.g. `"pp"`) or a true minus sign the active `valueFormat`/locale doesn't give. Superseded by `delta.format` when `delta` is set.

props.name: delta
props.description: Replaces/aliases `showDelta` + `deltaLabelFormat` (RM-116): one object, `mode` picking an absolute or a `%` delta. Wins over both when set.

props.name: bothEndsLabeled
props.description: `variant="slope"` only: label the END of each line with its category name too (`"{category} {value}"`, matching the START label), not just the bare value. Default `false` (byte-identical: end label stays value-only).

props.name: valueLabelFormat
props.description: `variant="slope"` only: custom formatter for the plain VALUE half of each end's label — receives the raw value and its row, returns just the value text (the chart still prepends `"{category} "` itself). Unset (default) keeps `formatValue` (the active `valueFormat`). `Intl` never pads a whole number, so an exact-integer reading (`92`) needs this to force a fixed decimal count (`"92.0"`) matching its neighbours' precision.

props.name: referenceLine
props.description: `orientation="horizontal"` (dumbbell variant) only: one labelled vertical reference line at `value` on the shared value scale (e.g. an industry benchmark). Unset (default) draws nothing.

props.name: showValueAxis
props.description: `orientation="horizontal"` (dumbbell variant) only: draws light tick marks + value labels along the bottom of the plot, from the same value scale. Default `false` (byte-identical: no axis). Superseded by `valueAxis` when set.

props.name: valueAxis
props.description: A richer value axis than `showValueAxis` — position (top/bottom) and domain rounding. Setting this also turns the axis on. See {@link DumbbellValueAxisConfig}.

props.name: sortBy
props.description: Sort rows before rendering. `"delta"` sorts **descending by `|delta|`** (magnitude, sign ignored — the biggest mover first, whether it's an increase or a decrease); `"deltaPercent"` is the same magnitude-first read for `delta / start`; `"start"`/`"end"`/`"label"` sort **ascending**; `"data"` is an explicit spelling of `"none"` (spreadsheet order). Default `"none"`.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the order `sortBy` resolves to. Default `false`.

props.name: palette
props.description: Which colour family rows draw from. Default `"categorical"`.

props.name: rowColor
props.description: Per-row colour override — return a `var(--…)` token to recolour that row's connector/markers/labels, or `undefined` to keep the row on the resolved `palette`. The one seam an "argument, not a chart" infographic needs to emphasise a row or two (a status tone) while the rest stay on the shared palette — never a second palette, since most rows should read as unremarkable, not as a competing category. Unset (default) is byte-identical to today's per-row palette colouring.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: How displayed numbers (the delta label) are formatted. Default `"compact"`.

props.name: margin
props.description: Chart margins.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Aspect ratio as `"width / height"`. Default `"2 / 1"`.

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint. Wins over `aspectRatio`, which stays an alias.

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. category count + value range).

props.name: annotations
props.description: Declarative annotations in data units (RM-111): text notes, ranges, reference lines and row notes. Ranges paint under the series, the rest over them; at the `narrow` tier each text note becomes a numbered marker listed in a key under the plot, and every annotation is restated once in the figure description. A row note tracks its row by category, so it still lands on the right row after `sortBy`/`groupBy` reorders it.

props.name: analytics
props.description: Statistical lines and bands computed from `data` (RM-138, ADR 0040 §1) — an average, a median, a percentile band — on the value axis, drawn through the annotation layer. `of` defaults to `startKey`; `"all"` pools both ends.

props.name: legend
props.description: Renders a legend (RM-118). `variant="dots"` draws one row per `valueKeys` entry, via `useContainerLegend` (placement + hover only, R3: hovering/focusing a row dims every OTHER dot key's dots, on every row, never hides one — a dumbbell row is a CATEGORY, not a series, so there is nothing per-key to hide). REPLACES the pre-existing, unconditional corner dot-key badge (`data-slot="dumbbell-chart-dot-legend"`, RM-116) when set; unset (default) keeps that badge exactly as it always rendered — it predates the shared legend engine and R1 ("unset renders nothing new") only governs what THIS prop adds, not existing UI. `"dumbbell"`/`"slope"`/`"arrow"` (#610) draw a two-entry start/end legend instead — each row IS its own category (already labelled beside its own mark), so there is no per-CATEGORY key to legend; what these three variants share across every row is the marker SHAPE at each end (`markers`, default hollow start / filled end), so the legend keys THAT: one hollow-swatch entry (`startLabel ?? startKey`), one filled-swatch entry (`endLabel ?? endKey`). Both entries share one neutral ink (`chartCssVars.foreground`) — shape, not colour, is what they teach, since each row already draws in its own category colour.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: `legend`'s start-marker entry label, two-marker variants only. Default: `startKey`.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: `legend`'s end-marker entry label, two-marker variants only. Default: `endKey`.

props.name: horizontal
props.description: `true` when the value axis runs horizontally (a horizontal bar chart).

props.name: cap
props.description: Cap length in px. Default 6.

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: The plot's own height (ADR 0039): px, or `{ aspect }` (width ÷ height), optionally per breakpoint.

props.name: hoveredIndex
props.description: Controlled hover state — index of the hovered segment

props.name: onHoverChange
props.description: Callback when hover state changes

props.name: staggerDelay
props.description: Stagger delay between segments in seconds. Default 0.12

props.name: enterTransition
props.description: Framer Motion transition for segment enter animation

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between segments in pixels. Default 4

props.name: renderPattern
props.description: Render a visx pattern definition. Receives a unique `id` string per segment and the resolved `color`. Return a `<PatternLines>` (or any visx pattern) inside an SVG `<defs>`. The component will use `fill="url(#id)"` on the innermost ring while keeping outer halo rings as solid color.

props.name: onDatapointClick
props.description: Drill-down (#349). Fires when a stage is activated by pointer OR keyboard. Setting it mounts a keyboard-operable target layer OUTSIDE the aria-hidden SVG — one tab stop, arrow keys to traverse. Unset changes nothing.

props.name: copyValueOnActivate
props.description: Put the datapoint's exact value on the clipboard when it is activated — the recovery path for a compact axis label. Default `false`; a chart with no interaction props still renders byte-identical DOM. A consumer-supplied `onDatapointClick` always wins.

props.name: datapointLabel
props.description: Override the accessible name of each keyboard drill-down target (#349).

props.name: maxInteractiveDatapoints
props.description: Dev-warning threshold on the number of keyboard targets. Default 500 (#349).

props.name: accessibleLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the chart region (announces to AT on focus).

props.name: accessibleDescription
props.description: Supplemental description read by AT (e.g. stage names + values).

props.name: legend
props.description: Container legend (#610, the RM-118 engine): mounts one key outside the plot, in the shared legend look every other chart uses. A funnel draws ONE measure — its stages are already labelled on the plot — so the key names that measure: one swatch in the chart's `color`, labelled `seriesLabel`. Static (`interactive` caps at `"none"`): with one measure there is no other series to dim or hide. Unset renders nothing (today's behaviour); a truthy `legend` with no `seriesLabel` also renders nothing.

props.name: seriesLabel
props.description: The measure's display name — the legend's one entry (see `legend`).

props.name: edges
props.description: Edge style for the funnel segments. Default "curved"

props.name: labelLayout
props.description: Controls how segment labels (value, percentage, stage name) are arranged. - "spread": Value/percentage/label are spread apart (top/center/bottom for horizontal, left/center/right for vertical). This is the default. - "grouped": All label items stack together in a tight group. When "grouped", use `labelOrientation` and `labelAlign` for full control.

props.name: labelOrientation
props.description: Stack direction of the label group. Only applies when `labelLayout="grouped"`. - "vertical": Items stack top-to-bottom. Default for horizontal funnels. - "horizontal": Items stack left-to-right. Default for vertical funnels.

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: Where the label group sits within the segment cell. - "center" (default), "start", "end" For horizontal funnel: start=top, end=bottom. For vertical funnel: start=left, end=right.

props.name: showConversion
props.description: Stage-to-stage conversion — the % of the PREVIOUS stage's value, rendered as a small opaque plate (lieflat L13's "62% GET THROUGH" margin note — the number funnel readers actually want, distinct from the existing `showPercentage` badge which is always "% of the first stage"). The plate carries its own ground/ink pair (like `SegmentLabel`'s percentage pill), so it stays legible on any band fill in any theme — see #239. - `"between"` places one annotation at the boundary between each pair of adjacent segments. - `"margin"` stacks all transitions in a column near the funnel's leading edge (left edge for horizontal, top edge for vertical). - `false` (default) renders nothing — an existing `FunnelChart` with no `showConversion` prop is unaffected. When set, the interactive stage overlay (hover/click target) also gets a native `title` tooltip reading "N% of previous stage · M% of first stage".

props.name: tasks
props.description: Task data.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Row height override (px). Defaults to density-derived value.

props.name: viewMode
props.description: Controlled tick granularity. Accepts any {@link GanttTimeUnit}.

props.name: defaultViewMode

props.name: onViewModeChange
